emails.subject: Order 789 - quotation and delivery
emails.body: We would like to place an order for 500 units of Product A. Please send us your revised quotation.

emails.subject: Re: Order 789 - quotation and delivery
emails.body: We can supply Product A at 1000 per unit. We will send the formal quotation shortly.

emails.subject: Re: Order 789 - quotation and delivery
emails.body: Please revise the quantity to 600 units. We would also like to discuss a discount for the larger order.

emails.subject: Re: Order 789 - quotation and delivery
emails.body: We can offer a 3% discount for 600 units. Please confirm whether you would like us to proceed with the revised quantity.

emails.subject: Re: Order 789 - quotation and delivery
emails.body: Yes, please proceed with 600 units and the 3% discount.

emails.subject: Re: Order 789 - quotation and delivery
emails.body: Confirmed. The revised order is 600 units with a 3% discount. Our warehouse expects to dispatch the order on September 22, 2026.

emails.subject: Re: Order 789 - quotation and delivery
emails.body: Please make sure the goods are dispatched by September 22 because we need them urgently.

emails.subject: Re: Order 789 - quotation and delivery
emails.body: There has been a delay at the warehouse. The revised expected dispatch date is September 24, 2026.

emails.subject: Re: Order 789 - quotation and delivery
emails.body: Understood. Please send the tracking number once the order is dispatched.
